title: Yummy Kenyan Rye Bread Toast
description: A rich, gooey toast that blends rye bread with fresh avocado, cherry tomatoes, and spinach, served on a binchotan grill for a smoky finish that helps cure hangovers and soothe inflammation.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill until it emits a light smoke.
Brush both sides of the rye bread slices with olive oil and season with sea salt and black pepper.
Place the bread on the grill and cook until the first side turns golden brown, about 2 minutes.
Flip the bread and cook the other side for an additional 1 minute, allowing the oil to seep into the crust.
Remove the bread from the grill and place it on a cutting board.
Spread the mashed avocado evenly over the warm slices.
Top the avocado with halved cherry tomatoes and fresh spinach.
Drizzle lemon juice over the vegetables and sprinkle with cayenne pepper if using.
Garnish with microgreens for a fresh finish.
Serve immediately while the bread is still warm and slightly crisp.
